description: This source file defines a static helper class 'ManageNavPages' for managing navigation page states within the manage section of a web application, including properties for page identifiers, methods for determining active page navigation class, and an extension method for setting the active page.

classes.name: ManageNavPages
classes.description: A static class providing helper methods and properties for managing navigation states in the web application's manage pages.

methods.name: ActivePageKey
methods.description: A static property that provides the key name for the active page in view data.

methods.name: Index
methods.description: A static property representing the identifier for the 'Index' page.

methods.name: ChangePassword
methods.description: A static property representing the identifier for the 'ChangePassword' page.

methods.name: ExternalLogins
methods.description: A static property representing the identifier for the 'ExternalLogins' page.

methods.name: TwoFactorAuthentication
methods.description: A static property representing the identifier for the 'TwoFactorAuthentication' page.

methods.name: PageNavClass
methods.description: Determines the CSS class for navigation items based on the current active page, returning 'active' if the page matches, otherwise an empty string.

methods.name: AddActivePage
methods.description: An extension method for ViewDataDictionary to set the current active page.
